posts.text:
I met with @NECattlemen to discuss New World Screwworm mitigation efforts.
 
With funding from @SenateGOP  directed at combatting this threat, @USDA  is leading the fight.
 
We also discussed my farm bill priorities including the fair labeling of beef products and strengthening support for producers recovering from wildfires. 

Nebraska is the beef state, I’ll never stop fighting for our farmers and ranchers.

posts.text:
After previously being eradicated in the United States, New World Screwworm has been confirmed in Texas.  NWS poses a serious threat to the health of our cattle and the cattle industry. It does not, however, pose food safety concerns for consumers.   

On behalf of Nebraska farmers and ranchers, I will be working with @USDA to eradicate this parasite again.

We will never forget the sacrifices made by the Greatest Generation to defend our freedoms.

.@SenateGOP is rewarding Nebraska seniors for a lifetime of hard work.  We created a $6,000 tax deduction for seniors, $12,000 for couples. This means 88% of American seniors won’t pay federal income taxes on their Social Security benefits.

When I was Governor, we exempted state income taxes on Social Security.  Now, the Working Families Tax Cuts makes this tax relief available for all American seniors.
